items.title: Per the Celtics, this afternoon, they assigned Chris Cenac Jr. and transferred Devin Carter, Dillon Mitchell and Amari Williams to their G League affiliate for their practice at the Auerbach Center.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Per the Celtics, this afternoon, they assigned Chris Cenac Jr. and transferred Devin Carter, Dillon Mitchell and Amari Williams to their G League affiliate for their practice at the Auerbach Center.

Following the conclusion of the practice, Cenac Jr. and Mitchell returned to the parent club.

items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Joe Mazzulla on Devin Carter, who has yet to play this season due to an illness:

“He’s in that reconditioning phase.”

items.title: Per the Celtics, Devin Carter (illness) remains out. Him being back around the team suggests he’s getting closer, though.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Per the Celtics, Devin Carter (illness) remains out. Him being back around the team suggests he’s getting closer, though.

Carter is the only player on the Celtics’ injury report before tomorrow’s NBA Cup contest against the Bulls.

items.title: Interesting injury report on the back-to-back with only Devin Carter (out-illness) and Derrick White (Probable, Right Hip Synovitis) listed. Seems like Paul George and Mitchell Robinson are available. Let's see how that plays out tonight.

No changes to the Celtics' injury report. Devin Carter remains out due to illness -- did not see him at the facility today.

Carter is the only player on Boston's injury report ahead of tomorrow's game against the Bulls at TD Garden.
